title: Хаб: management listener (livez/readyz/metrics), shutdown coordinator с дедлайном, лимиты, проверка версии протокола
summary: `src/management.js` (`MANAGEMENT_HOST` default 127.0.0.1 : `MANAGEMENT_PORT`; `/livez` без БД/backend/Redis; `/readyz` — WS слушает, кэшированный статус backend, Redis при обязательном Redis, протокол 2 совместим, не draining; `/metrics` Prometheus text без новых зависимостей), `src/shutdown.js` (`stopOnSignals: false`; SIGTERM/SIGINT → draining → readyz 503 → отказ upgrade/admission → writes stopped → flush ledger ≤ `SHUTDOWN_FLUSH_MS` 30 000 → закрыть 4503 → destroy в race с `SHUTDOWN_DESTROY_MS` 5 000 → лог error с unflushed и exit 1 либо exit 0), `src/limits.js` (MAX_UPDATE_BYTES, MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES, MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, MAX_ROOMS_PER_TENANT, MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_ROOM, MAX_UPDATES_PER_SECOND_PER_ROOM), `src/metrics.js`; `/health` на 0.0.0.0 удалён; несовместимый протокол backend → readyz false.
why: collaboration#hub-ops и D26: readiness не останавливает established WS — нужен write-quiescence; Hocuspocus 4.3.0 destroy висит после failed store (P5.2); liveness не зависит от БД. Hard risks: SIGTERM без дедлайна (под не завершается, rollout стоит); записи, принятые после границы drain (10); нечестный unflushed count; management-порт наружу; лимит после аллокации (17).

include: Node-тесты: test/{management,shutdown,limits,metrics}.test.js; правка websocket-hardening/security тестов под новые лимиты
exclude: Реальный SIGTERM под нагрузкой с двумя хабами (stand 10, P5.13 — пишется)

reads.why: границы P5, точные команды качества, размещение тестов, схема, ledger, прогрессия инвариантов
факты Hocuspocus 4.3.0, ledger, режимы, компактация, shutdown, management, лимиты
сценарии I17 этого пункта: линия и файл
Fast-набор D41: что исполняется в пункте
чекпоинты P5: что покрывает, база диапазона, фокус

rules: Один обработчик сигналов — shutdown coordinator; `stopOnSignals: false` в конфигурации Server.
После выставления draining ни одна запись (envelope, update, sync step 2) не принимается; readyz 503 возвращается до закрытия соединений.
destroy() всегда в race с таймаутом; итоговый лог содержит число нефлашнутых записей и document_id.
Management listener по умолчанию слушает 127.0.0.1; /livez не обращается к backend, БД и Redis.
guidance: shutdown.test.js: координатор с инъекцией clock и фейковых server/ledger: (a) сигнал → readyz 503 сразу, onConnect отказывает, beforeHandleMessage отвергает запись; (b) ledger флашится до дедлайна → exit 0; (c) ledger не флашится → по дедлайну лог error `{unflushed: n, documents: [...]}`, exit 1; (d) destroy не резолвится → завершение по SHUTDOWN_DESTROY_MS. Тест не шлёт реальный сигнал процессу Node test runner (вызывает обработчик напрямую).

validation.cmd: (cd packages/collaboration/hub && npm run check && node --test test/management.test.js test/shutdown.test.js test/limits.test.js test/metrics.test.js)

validation.expect: exit 0: весь unit-набор хаба (test/*.test.js), без e2e/stand

reviewer.note: RC-P5-2: покрывает P5.7–P5.9 (git diff -M <sha P5.6>..<sha P5.9>). Фокус: ack только после backend commit, неизменный update_id при retry, retry-классы и общий дедлайн, ledger независим от onStoreDocument/debounce/destroy, Redis-origin не дублируется, server/direct-изменения не теряются, бюджет buffered → stop writes, отказ durable; компактация по lease и CAS, covered диапазон = прочитанному; shutdown: readyz 503 сразу, admission/mutation закрыты, destroy в race с таймаутом, честный unflushed; liveness без БД; лимиты до аллокации. Сверка с закреплёнными фактами Hocuspocus 4.3.0 (test/hocuspocus-v4.test.js).

result.notes:
P5.9 hub operations. New src/management.js: loopback-by-default listener (VAULTER_COLLAB_MANAGEMENT_HOST 127.0.0.1 : VAULTER_COLLAB_MANAGEMENT_PORT 1235). /livez answers from the event loop only; /readyz is 503 unless the WS server listens, the backend gave a 2xx within VAULTER_COLLAB_READY_BACKEND_TTL_MS (cached status from instrumentBackend over every hub call; the worker's lease call every interval is the heartbeat, the probe calls nothing), the protocol is compatible (409 collaboration_protocol_mismatch makes it false, any later 2xx clears it), Redis clients are ready when Redis is configured, and the hub is not draining. /metrics serves Prometheus text (src/metrics.js registry, no new deps, every collab_* metric of p5-design plus pending_bytes, appended/dropped, limit_rejections{limit}, writes_stopped, draining, ready; no room/document labels). /stats kept for the load harness. startHealthEndpoint, /health on 0.0.0.0 and healthPort/VAULTER_COLLAB_HEALTH_PORT removed. New src/shutdown.js: the one SIGTERM/SIGINT handler (Server stopOnSignals: false; no other module installs signal handlers). draining=true synchronously (readyz 503, onConnect/onAuthenticate refuse, a connection that lands meanwhile closes 4503) -> persistence.stopWrites('draining') (writers read-only, so Hocuspocus drops sync step 2/updates; envelopes nacked writes_stopped retry:true; serverWrite refused) -> ledger flush loop until empty or VAULTER_COLLAB_SHUTDOWN_FLUSH_MS 30000 (blocked records retried every 200 ms), worker.stop alongside -> closeEveryRoom 4503 draining -> destroy() raced with VAULTER_COLLAB_SHUTDOWN_DESTROY_MS 5000 -> unflushed counted after destroy -> log.error(message, {unflushed, documents, rooms}) and exit 1, else exit 0; cancellable timers; a repeated signal is ignored; a failing step is logged and does not stop the drain. New src/limits.js (imports nothing): MAX_UPDATE_BYTES 1 MiB, MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES 16 MiB, MAX_REQUEST_BYTES 2 MiB, MAX_ROOMS_PER_TENANT 1000, MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_ROOM 100, MAX_UPDATES_PER_SECOND_PER_ROOM 200 (VAULTER_COLLAB_* env, validated). Sizes come from lengths or headers before decoding. A raw message over its size closes 4413 in beforeHandleMessage; an oversized stateless payload is nacked before JSON.parse; an envelope is nacked collaboration_update_too_large from its base64 length before decoding. A per-room token bucket per channel: sync writes close 4429, envelopes nack rate_limited retry:true. Connections per room are checked at onConnect and registered at connected (a concurrent overshoot closes 4429); rooms per tenant use the token's tenant claim after the backend accepted it. A backend body over the limit is never sent and answers a local 413 collaboration_update_too_large (checkpoint gets base64 of MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES on top). Document size: estimate plus Y.encodeStateAsUpdate measure at most once per 64 KiB of growth; a full room mutes its writers (status writes:stopped reason document_too_large) and nacks document_too_large unless the room already holds the update (state-vector check), so a sync-first update is still appended. persistence.js: stopWrites, per-room stop reasons in status, protocolCompatible (fix: protocolMismatch was sticky), revokedStillConnected, isWriteMessage moved to limits.js and re-exported. backend.js: authenticate returns status; request-size gate. index.js: hooks onConnect/onAuthenticate/connected/beforeHandleMessage/onDisconnect wire draining and limits; boot() builds the instrumented backend, readiness, metrics, management and coordinator (installed before listen). Dockerfile: HEALTHCHECK -> /livez on the management port, MANAGEMENT_HOST=127.0.0.1, EXPOSE 1234 only, STOPSIGNAL SIGTERM. Hub docker-compose: management env, management port not published (commented loopback option), stop_grace_period 40s, healthcheck /livez. Tests: new test/{management,shutdown,limits,metrics}.test.js; security/webhook/websocket-hardening adjusted; tests/baseline rewritten with `scripts/t baseline --write -p hub` (hub 22 -> 26). Other commands run: npm run check (exit 0); node --test retry/ledger/webhook/v1-paths/config/security/management/metrics (100 pass, exit 0); `scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub` (exit 0); under throwaway yjs/hocuspocus/tiptap/ws stubs loaded with `node --import $TMPDIR/p59-stubs/register.mjs` (not committed): limits+shutdown 31/31 pass, modes/envelope/readonly/collab-expiry/epoch-fence/on-connect 50/50 pass, the new websocket-hardening P5.9 case passes.
Changed: e2e/docker-compose.yml, load/docker-compose.load.yml, packages/collaboration/hub/Dockerfile, packages/collaboration/hub/docker-compose.yml, packages/collaboration/hub/package.json, packages/collaboration/hub/src/backend.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/cli.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/config.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/index.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/limits.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/management.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/metrics.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/persistence.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/rooms.js, packages/collaboration/hub/src/shutdown.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/limits.test.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/management.test.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/metrics.test.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/security.test.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/shutdown.test.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/webhook.test.js, packages/collaboration/hub/test/websocket-hardening.test.js, scripts/collab-e2e.sh, tests/baseline/CHANGES.json, tests/baseline/CHANGES.md, tests/baseline/hub.count, tests/baseline/hub.list
deviations: V1's node --test part exits 1 in this sandbox only because yjs/@hocuspocus/* cannot be resolved (root node_modules masked, registry.npmjs.org refused, no yjs tarball in the npm cache), as in P5.7/P5.8. 40 of 50 tests pass; all 10 failures are 'Cannot find package yjs'. They are the 9 Yjs-backed cases of limits.test.js and the hooks/persistence drain scenario of shutdown.test.js. Under throwaway stubs in $TMPDIR (append-only fake CRDT, stub Server/Throttle/transformer/tiptap/ws, loaded with --import) they all pass, but stub byte sizes differ from real Yjs. The document-size test is sized with margin for real Yjs encodings (room ~110 bytes measured plus a 140-byte update against a 200-byte limit). V2 and the new websocket-hardening case were not run against real Hocuspocus.

Changed outside scope.write_set: packages/collaboration/hub/package.json (the check script names the four new src files); e2e/docker-compose.yml, load/docker-compose.load.yml and scripts/collab-e2e.sh (they used VAULTER_COLLAB_HEALTH_PORT and /health, both removed; now management port and /livez). The load stand sets VAULTER_COLLAB_MANAGEMENT_HOST=0.0.0.0 because CollaborationRoomMetrics reads http://hocuspocus:1235/stats from another container, and its published port is narrowed to 127.0.0.1:1235.

Bug fixed on the spot (D43): persistence's protocolMismatch flag was sticky. One 409 collaboration_protocol_mismatch (for example from an old backend pod during a rollout) stopped durable writes until restart, and reportProtocolMismatch did not re-evaluate writes. Now a committed append (ledger acked) or any 2xx seen by the instrumented backend clears it (protocolCompatible), and reportProtocolMismatch re-evaluates writes at once.

V4 (scripts/t baseline --compare, all suites) was not run as written: vue discovery (npx vitest list) needs the npm registry, which this sandbox refuses (as in P5.4–P5.8). `scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub` exits 0 after `scripts/t baseline --write -p hub` (hub: current 26).
